notes.title: 2024 Novemver 8 - Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hello,

In this update:
- FPS setting
- Bad looking bushes remove for MacOS
- Spiders removed from inside the house
- Grabbing objects easier
- Other small fixes.

Thank you all!
Edy

notes.title: 2024 November 4 - Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hello lovely people,

- The drop of item correctly inside the truck has been fixed.
- Other small fixes

Thank you,
Edy

notes.title: 2024 November - Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

- I fixed the issue when a players joins a lobby of a player who just played single player
- The microphone selected in Settings will be the one available for talking in Lobby and game
- Audio talk lag fixed
- Other small changes

Thank you all!
Edy

notes.title: 2024 November 2 - Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hello lovely people.

In this hotfix:
- Stamina will last longer so that you can run more
- Faster grab of the flashlight
- Crazy horror sound for Weeper and Spider attacks
- Audio immersion improved
- Other small changes

As always, your sincere,
Edy

notes.title: 2024 November 1 - Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

In this hotfix update I fixed the following:

1. Multiplayer latency issue for the guest (now the guest will no longer have low FPS due to latency)

2. Medieval Paper now can be grabbed and seen on multiplayer games by the guest

3. Performance improvements

4. Other small bug fixes.

Thank you all,
Edy
